declared_before: any wiring change, any deploy, and any charged oracle call of this experiment

experiment.name: pmo_construction_prior_ab_celecoxib_250

arms.CP_OFF: deployed B (allocator repair + online structural memory), construction prior ABSENT
arms.CP_ON: identical to CP_OFF plus the learned construction-lane prior on every construction draw the shallow lane makes

experiment.matched: identical initialization (16 charged, same lock), identical controller seed 20260920, identical budget, identical executor, identical oracle, identical allocator, identical macro scheduling, identical exploration policy. The ONLY declared difference is the presence of the construction prior.

checkpoint_status.label: DEVELOPMENT_ONLY_CONSTRUCTION_PRIOR_QUALIFICATION
checkpoint_status.reason: configs/ringcore_v1_checkpoint_selection.json forbids this checkpoint for frozen results: it was selected by hazard-inclusive GM loss, an explicitly forbidden criterion. The owner authorized its use as a DEVELOPMENT QUALIFICATION only. No number produced by this experiment may become a publication number.

prior_evidence_zero_oracle.note: Every figure above is a CHEMISTRY measurement with zero oracle calls. None of them is a scored-search result. This experiment tests whether the chemistry effect translates into scored search.

decision_rule.note: This rule is committed BEFORE any score of this experiment is read. It is evaluated on the primary metrics below and nothing else.
secondary_metrics: population QED and SA trajectory by charged-call quartile
best-molecule proximity to the known productive region
proposal-family attribution of frontier improvements over the charged-call prefix

PROMOTE_TO_BASE.condition: the prior improves CHEMISTRY (QED/SA drift) AND improves score or productive-region proximity
PROMOTE_TO_BASE.action: the prior becomes the new base B'; large retentive and macro proposals get retested on top of it later

KEEP_AS_MANIFOLD_MECHANISM.condition: the prior improves CHEMISTRY but does NOT improve score
KEEP_AS_MANIFOLD_MECHANISM.action: keep it as a manifold mechanism; the next step is a learned GLOBAL goal/completion proposer, not more tuning here

REJECT.action: do not rationalize and do not keep tuning it against celecoxib

decision_rule.reporting_commitment: If the scored effect is null or negative, that is reported FIRST. A null is the more valuable result: it shows off-manifold drift is not sufficient to explain basin discovery.

known_confound_declared_in_advance.wall_clock: The proposal loop terminates on whichever comes first of CHANNEL_CANDIDATE_LIMIT candidates, attempts_per_batch attempts, or config.wall_seconds = 45.0 (adaptive_program_optimizer.py and dynamic_program_synthesis_v21._generate_channel_pool). The prior costs a model forward per distinct source state, so the ON arm may complete FEWER proposal attempts in the same wall budget. Per-round attempt counts and proposal seconds will be reported for both arms so a score difference cannot be silently attributed to chemistry when it is attrition.
known_confound_declared_in_advance.commitment: If the ON arm makes materially fewer attempts per round, that is reported beside the score and the score difference is labelled CONFOUNDED rather than attributed to the prior.

prior_aware_lanes: shallow_program_channel via pmo_online_memory.memory_channel_proposal (the warm-memory lane arm B actually uses)
NOT_prior_aware: structured_program_channel (routes through dynamic_program_synthesis_v1, a different module)
scope_declared_in_advance.note: This is a partial-coverage mechanism by construction. A null result is therefore a null about the shallow construction lane, not about a chemical prior in general.
